title: MCP OpenAPI Configuration
description: Configuration for the MCP OpenAPI extension. Exposes the operations of an OpenAPI spec as MCP tools.

spec.description: OpenAPI 3.x or Swagger 2.0 specification in YAML or JSON format.

include_ops.description: Operations to expose as tools. When set, only these operations are exposed. Operations are identified by their operationId, or by the generated tool name when the operationId is absent.

exclude_ops.description: Operations not to expose as tools. Operations are identified by their operationId, or by the generated tool name when the operationId is absent.

SpecSource.description: The source of the OpenAPI specification. Exactly one of inline, file or url must be set.

inline.description: Spec provided directly as a string.

file.description: Path to a file containing the spec.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the spec, fetched when the configuration is loaded.
